name: Elephant
summary: Standing on the carriage with hands on the footbar, move the carriage with the legs while the upper body stays still.
steps: Stand on the carriage, hands on the footbar with the shoulders over it.
Both feet flat against the shoulder rests, legs straight.
Breathe in to push the carriage back with the legs, upper body still.
Breathe out to pull it home using the abdominals.
modifications: Bend the knees or lift the heels for tight hamstrings or calves.
Take spring off only once it is steady.

cautions.note: Hands on the footbar take some weight.
Rounded spine under load; teach the flat-back version.

cues:
Heels stay heavy on the carriage.
Go as far as you can without the shoulders moving.
Soft elbows and knees.
Chin off the chest.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
